claim: The European Union AI Act establishes binding safety requirements for AI systems placed on the EU market.

annotation.adjudication_rationale: Both European Parliament and European Commission official notices confirm the EU AI Act establishes binding safety requirements in EU territory.

gold_evidence.exact_quote: Parliament on Wednesday approved the Artificial Intelligence Act, ensuring safety and compliance with fundamental rights for AI systems on the EU market.
The European Artificial Intelligence Act enters into force today, introducing harmonised rules across EU Member States.
